name: The LJ Speech Dataset
description: The LJ Speech Dataset is a public domain speech corpus comprising 13,100 short audio clips of a single speaker reading passages from seven non-fiction books. Totaling approximately 24 hours of audio recorded in English, the clips range in duration from 1 to 10 seconds and are accompanied by exact text transcriptions, widely serving as the standard benchmark for neural text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis and vocoder evaluation.
